question: Who among the following is one of the members of the Pakistan National Movement, who had coined the name Pakistan in 1933?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Choudhry Rehmat Ali.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• On **28 January 1933**, **Choudhry Rehmat Ali** express his ideas on 'Pakistan'.
 
• He is credited with producing the name** "Pakistan"** for a separate Muslim homeland in South Asia and is normally famous as the** originator of the Pakistan Movement.**
 
• Pakistan is the **138th wealthiest country in the world.**
 
• **Rahmat Ali and three Cambridge colleagues** invented the name as an acronym for Punjab, Afghania , Kashmir, and Indus-Sind, combined with the -stan suffix from Baluchistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohammed Ali Jinnah** was the originator and first governor-general (1947–48) of Pakistan. ​ 
 
• **Maulana Azad** supported the **Khilafat Movement. **
 
• **Muhammad Umar** was originator of Fiqh, or Islamic jurisprudence.
